einzeiler: Prediction markets, social investing platforms and the Mormon church's real estate empire
kurzfassung: This weekend episode explores the rising risks of gambling addiction tied to prediction markets and their similarities to traditional sports betting. It also examines the growth of social investing app Dubb, which allows users to automatically copy trades from prominent figures and fund managers. Finally, the program investigates the massive and secretive real estate portfolio accumulated by the Mormon church across the United States.
stichpunkte: Prediction markets face increased scrutiny over addiction risks and user vulnerabilities similar to sports gambling.
Kalshi maintains that it is not a sportsbook since users trade against each other rather than the house.
Social investing platform Dubb allows retail traders to automatically follow portfolios of politicians, hedge funds, and top traders.
Dubb operates on a monthly subscription model and positions itself as a talent marketplace for retail investment managers.
Grand Theft Auto 6 gameplay footage debuted exclusively on Netflix, outperforming major streaming content.
The Mormon church owns at least 2.4 million acres of land in the U.S., valued at over $20 billion.
Commercial real estate arms of the Mormon church operate similarly to sovereign wealth funds with a generational investment horizon.

kapitel.titel: Grand Theft Auto 6 Trailer on Netflix
The Mormon Church's Real Estate Empire

clips.hook: The core experience of prediction markets
clips.text: The fundamental mechanics of placing wagers on future events deliver the exact same dopamine rush and loss-chasing behavior associated with traditional sports betting.
Federal oversight remains largely absent, leaving platforms to voluntarily implement consumer protections and self-regulate.

clips.hook: The vast land ownership of the Mormon church
clips.text: Public records show the religious institution controls at least 2.4 million acres of property, an area roughly equivalent to two Delawares.

clips.hook: An all-cash advantage in real estate
clips.text: Higher borrowing rates give the church a distinct market advantage because it can purchase properties entirely in cash while taking a generational view.
